title: Director at Managed Security Firm Sees Samsara Gaining Fleet Share and Accelerating Joint Business Growth
expert: Channel sales director at a large U.S. telecom/managed security provider co-selling Samsara to large enterprises
verdict: The expert's Samsara-related business grew 20%–22% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026 with a 96% renewal rate and a joint pipeline up about 30%.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🟢 96% of customers renewed, joint pipeline +30% y/y, 20%–25% new logos; vs Jefferies check that license cost is a focus at renewals (SB #62601): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↑
🟡 25%–27% CY26 growth (estimate), partner practice below company ARR +29.6% and $100K+ cohort +38% (SB #50486); first expert read.
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🟢 Platform deals +5%–7% y/y price, basic GPS no more than 2%–3%, first read on price realization; pricing on AI video and asset tracking helps offset the component-cost GM cut (SB #62580). → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) ↑
Competition & share: 🟢 Number one or two in RFPs, gaining vs Motive and Geotab, matches Jefferies platform wins (SB #62604); complex projects still need aggressive discounts. → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↑

changes: Renewals: 96% renewal rate vs Jefferies reseller check that license cost is scrutinised at renewal when fleets shrink (SB #62601): conflicting.
Growth: partner business +20%–22% y/y vs company $100K+ cohort ARR +38% (SB #50486): partner slower than company aggregate.
Pricing: first read on Samsara price realization (+5%–7% platform, ≤2%–3% basic); no earlier expert call or stored row.
Competition: platform RFP wins vs Jefferies 'competitors very aggressive on price in larger enterprise deals' (SB #62604): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): ↑ — +20%–22% practice growth, 96% renewals, pipeline +30%.
Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost): ↑ — +5%–7% price on platform deals.
Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↑ — #1/#2 in RFPs; caveat: aggressive discounts in complex projects.
